title: Me
description: Identity view returned by /auth/me. Combines profile, org memberships, and the active org context.

user.description: Profile derived from IdP or local account.

memberships.description: All org memberships for the user.

activeOrg.description: Present when the access token is org-bound; null/omitted for pre-org sessions.

rolesResolved.description: Resolved roles for convenience (immutable slug + mutable name).
